purpose: Canonical reason-code registry for future guardrail decisions. This registry is documentation/data only in Sprint 37.0 and must not be treated as runtime enforcement yet.

reason_codes.description_en: The user input is not a structural engineering task or cannot be mapped to a supported engineering domain.
reason_codes.description_nb: Brukarinndata er ikkje ei byggingeniøroppgåve eller kan ikkje knytast til eit støtta fagdomene.
reason_codes.trigger_condition: Input contains no relevant structural problem, values, geometry, load context or engineering intent.
reason_codes.user_message_en: The input does not look like a structural engineering task. Please provide a beam, column, slab, load, material or calculation problem.
reason_codes.developer_message: Block pipeline before engineering agents run. Store rejected input for review if logging is enabled.

reason_codes.description_en: The input is relevant but lacks data required for a reliable calculation.
reason_codes.description_nb: Inndata er relevant, men manglar data som trengst for ei påliteleg berekning.
reason_codes.trigger_condition: Essential values such as span, load, support condition, material, profile or section dimensions are missing.
reason_codes.user_message_en: The result is preliminary because important input data is missing.
reason_codes.developer_message: Allow limited educational output, but prevent strong approval language.

reason_codes.description_en: A section/profile capacity check needs verified section properties that are not available in the input or verified data source.
reason_codes.description_nb: Ein profil-/kapasitetskontroll treng verifiserte tverrsnittseigenskapar som ikkje ligg i input eller verifisert datakjelde.
reason_codes.trigger_condition: The response attempts steel, timber, concrete or other section-capacity checks without verified section properties.
reason_codes.user_message_en: Full capacity verification requires verified section properties. Do not treat this as final code compliance.
reason_codes.developer_message: Prevent invented profile-table values and final compliance claims.

reason_codes.description_en: The output appears to invent table values from a design standard or manual without verified source data.
reason_codes.description_nb: Svaret ser ut til å finne på tabellverdiar frå standard/handbok utan verifisert kjeldegrunnlag.
reason_codes.trigger_condition: AISC, Eurocode, material table, profile table or national annex values are asserted without verified source or explicit input.
reason_codes.user_message_en: The calculation cannot claim verified code-table values unless those values are provided or sourced.
reason_codes.developer_message: This is a high-risk hallucination class. Block or downgrade output before display.

reason_codes.description_en: The output mixes incompatible design-standard contexts.
reason_codes.trigger_condition: Eurocode notation/factors appear in AISC/ASCE context, or US notation/combinations appear in Eurocode/Norway context.
reason_codes.user_message_en: The calculation mixes design standards and must be clarified before it can be trusted.
reason_codes.developer_message: Flag standardProfile/answerLanguage/shellLanguage mismatch and require new run or controller downgrade.

reason_codes.description_en: The output mixes units or converts units inconsistently.
reason_codes.description_nb: Svaret blandar einingar eller konverterer einingar inkonsistent.
reason_codes.trigger_condition: Metric and US customary units are mixed without explicit conversion, or moment/shear/load units are inconsistent.
reason_codes.user_message_en: The result has unit-consistency risk and must be checked before use.
reason_codes.developer_message: Prefer warning for recoverable display errors; block if the numeric result depends on the unit error.

reason_codes.description_en: The conclusion is stronger than the available evidence supports.
reason_codes.description_nb: Konklusjonen er sterkare enn grunnlaget tillèt.
reason_codes.trigger_condition: Output says approved, safe, compliant or final when data is missing or checks are incomplete.
reason_codes.user_message_en: The conclusion must be treated as preliminary and requires professional verification.
reason_codes.developer_message: Controller/Reporter should avoid final approval language unless full verification is available.

reason_codes.description_en: The system claims final code compliance or professional approval without human review.
reason_codes.description_nb: Systemet påstår endeleg regelverkssamsvar eller profesjonell godkjenning utan menneskeleg kontroll.
reason_codes.trigger_condition: Report claims final compliance, licensed approval, construction-ready design or equivalent authority without human_review_status.
reason_codes.user_message_en: PILAR can provide preliminary assistance only. Final design requires qualified professional review.
reason_codes.developer_message: This should remain blocked until human review workflow exists.

reason_codes.description_en: A user-facing report or calculation note lacks a preliminary-use disclaimer.
reason_codes.description_nb: Ein rapport eller eit berekningsnotat manglar førebels-/ansvarsfråskrivingsmerknad.
reason_codes.trigger_condition: Result, full report, PDF, Word or calculation sheet is produced without clear preliminary/professional-review language.
reason_codes.user_message_en: This report is preliminary and must be checked by a qualified professional before use.
reason_codes.developer_message: Reporter/rendering layers should enforce this before export.

reason_codes.description_en: The web result, full report, PDF, Word or calculation sheet appear to disagree.
reason_codes.description_nb: Webresultat, fullrapport, PDF, Word eller berekningsark ser ut til å vere ulike.
reason_codes.trigger_condition: Different artifacts show different status, language, values, labels, warnings or conclusion wording.
reason_codes.user_message_en: Different report artifacts may not match. Use the latest verified view and rerun export.
reason_codes.developer_message: Synthetic User / Report QA should compare artifacts before release.

reason_codes.description_en: The report shell leaks labels from the wrong UI/shell language.
reason_codes.description_nb: Rapportskalet lekk labels frå feil UI-/shell-språk.
reason_codes.trigger_condition: Norwegian shell shows English role/status labels, or international shell shows Norwegian shell/status labels.
reason_codes.user_message_en: Some interface/report labels may be in the wrong language, but the calculation content may still be inspectable.
reason_codes.developer_message: Separate shellLanguage, answerLanguage and standardProfile. Do not solve by broad source replacement.

reason_codes.description_en: Generated agent prose leaks internal or wrong-language role names.
reason_codes.description_nb: Generert agenttekst lekk interne eller feil-språklege rollenamn.
reason_codes.trigger_condition: Agent-generated prose includes Konstruktør/Comparator/Controller in the wrong language context or mixes role languages.
reason_codes.user_message_en: Some generated text may contain inconsistent role names. Treat the technical result as preliminary.
reason_codes.developer_message: This belongs to agent prompt/output policy, not only render-layer i18n.

reason_codes.description_en: A guardrail decision refers to a reason code that is not registered.
reason_codes.description_nb: Ei guardrail-avgjerd viser til ein grunnkode som ikkje er registrert.
reason_codes.trigger_condition: guardrail_decisions.reason_codes contains an unknown or malformed reason code.
reason_codes.user_message_en: A system quality-control warning was generated and should be reviewed.
reason_codes.developer_message: Validator should fail unknown reason codes before runtime storage is introduced.

reason_codes.description_en: A patch/release step has not passed required verification gates.
reason_codes.description_nb: Eit patch-/release-steg har ikkje passert påkravde verifikasjonsgates.
reason_codes.trigger_condition: TypeScript, build, eval readiness, agent hub, or required runtime checks are missing or failing.
reason_codes.user_message_en: The release should not proceed until verification gates pass.
reason_codes.developer_message: Use this reason for Release Manager / Patch Planner gates, not user-facing calculation blocking.
